title: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive…
description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data version 5.4.0.0 contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability requires authentication and does not involve user interaction. It has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.4.
